wars.outcome: 'This independence was ended by Timur, who invaded Sistan in 1383 and caused extensive devastation to the province'; the Mihrabanids were Timurid vassals from then (Mihrabanids page; Sistan page: '1383 Tamerlane conquered Sistan and forced Mihrabanids to become vassals').

wars.name: Uzbek invasion of Sistan

zones.text: Sistan (Nimruz): the country of the dynasty

wars.outcome: The Timurid overlordship 'was ended in 1507 due to Uzbek invasion'; 'Uzbeks were driven in 1510 and Mihrabanids became vassals of Safavids until 1537' (Sistan page). The Mihrabanids page: Timurid vassals 'until the latter's overthrow by the Shaybanids'.

certainty.note: Only Sistan and Quhistan are named; no frontier. The 1289 Quhistan conquest is 'by 1289'. The independence from 1335 to 1383 (Sistan page) and the vassalages are status, not frontiers.

notes:
A state Cliopatria lacks (cliopatria_names []). Two pages opened (Mihrabanids, Sistan), plus the Nasrid page used for the nasrid-dynasty-of-sistan dossier. Wikidata id not obtainable: null.
Territory: Sistan (Nimruz) and, by 1289, Quhistan (drawn as South Khorasan province). No frontier is given; the Mihrabanids page has no area. 'Their capital was generally the city of Shahr-i Sistan' (Zaranj).
Status (suzerain-side events not recorded here, undated or recorded in the suzerain's dossier): after 1256 'the maliks recognized the Ilkhans as their overlords' (ulus-of-hulegu); 'Sistan declared independence in 1335 after demise of Ilkhanate' (Sistan page; 'independent for almost half a century' on the Mihrabanids page) until Timur's 1383 conquest; Timurid vassals from 1383 (timurid-empire); the Timurid overlordship ended in 1507 with the Uzbek invasion, and from 1510 the maliks were Safavid vassals (safavid-dynasty). The Mihrabanids 'intermittently fought against the Kartid maliks of Herat, who were also Ilkhanid vassals' (undated: no war recorded).
Mirrors: khwarezmid-empire has no Sistan gain in 1225 / loss to the Mongols (Sistan page: the Khwarezmians ended the Nasrids in 1225); mongol-empire and ulus-of-hulegu carry no Sistan events for 1236-1335; the timurid-empire 1383 gain is Herat, with Sistan only in Cliopatria's 1385 shape; safavid-dynasty has no 1537 Sistan gain.
Not settled: the Mihrabanid rulers between 1255 and 1495; what the Mongols held in Sistan between 1225 and 1236; whether Quhistan was lost before 1537; the end year (infobox 1537; 'the mid-16th century' in the text).
Gazetteer names used that it lacks: none.
